svg.title: Local Reference condition and safe exits
svg.desc: A Reference starts with exact local bytes for the current server head. Local editing or a newer server head can occur independently. A modified current Reference can become a working copy only after the server grants Checkout against that same Generation. A modified out-of-date Reference cannot publish directly and remains safe while the user chooses a copy, a new document, deliberate reapplication to a fresh Checkout, or confirmed discard.
